instruction: PART 3: The word in capitals at the end of each of the following lines can be used to form a word that fits in the blank space in the text. Fill in each space in this way. Spelling mistakes will be penalized.

items.questionText: Every year, the students at Greenfield High School vote for a new student council president. This year, many students are excited about the ______ (ELECT).
However, critics say that the constant campaigning can cause ______ (IRRITATE) among some students, especially if they are busy with project work, studying or preparing for exams.
Maria, one candidate, promises to improve the school's recycling program and promote ______ (CONSERVE).
Another candidate, Tom wants to help students manage their money by providing free classes on ______ (FINANCE) literacy.
Maria had to miss a few days of school due to illness, so her friend Alex acted as her ______ (SUBSTITUTION). This helped her stay in the race.

The school is also celebrating Citizenship Week, teaching students about their rights and responsibilities. The principal emphasizes ______ (PUNCTUAL), believing being on time shows respect and helps everything run smoothly.
At the end of the week, there is a big celebration. However, some students seem more interested in winning prizes, which others view as ______ (GREED) behavior.

instruction: PART 4: Below you will find different meanings of the bolded word. Choose the option that matches the sentence.

items.questionText:

options.text: a written or spoken description of something that has happened
an arrangement in which a bank keeps your money safe so that you can pay more in or take money out

items.questionText:

options.text: something that you are given, without asking for it, on a special occasion, especially to show friendship, or to say thank you

options.text: A rule or directive made and maintained by an authority.
